purpose: Local side-tangle composition criterion for Menasco1984 Lemma1 case2; not a link prime decomposition theorem.
interface: AC_omega; supplied smooth ball boundary sum and one marked arc in each factor, with closed components allowed.
proof_plan: A trivial total arc closes to an unknot, then apply two-point-sphere ball-arc lemma to each factor. Conversely align boundary-parallelism disks along the gluing disk and glue them.
